title: HR The Soother Fell Into Dragon Land

endings.2: HR happy: the soother comes home and the dragons keep the boot

beats.ch01.s01.b001: HR The sun is warm and the clothesline flaps.
beats.ch01.s01.b003: HR Pip will not stop crying.
beats.ch01.s01.b004: HR I have had enough of this soother.
beats.ch01.s01.b005: HR The soother spins up into the green sky.
beats.ch01.s01.b008: HR That was Pip's favourite thing.
beats.ch01.s02.b001: HR The sky is green and bubbles pop with a soft plop.
beats.ch01.s02.b003: HR That is my brother's soother.
beats.ch01.s02.b004: HR We can trade for it.
beats.ch01.s02.b005: HR I have a red boot.
beats.ch02.s01.b001: HR The cave walls sparkle like gold and Grumble snores on a pile of treasures.
beats.ch02.s01.b003: HR What is in it for me?
beats.ch02.s02.b001: HR The friendly wind sets Petra down by the clothesline.
beats.ch02.s02.b003: HR Pip, look what I found.
beats.ch02.s02.b004: HR Pip grins and throws the soother again.
beats.ch02.s02.b006: HR At least the dragons are happy.
